name: tour-travel-project
description: Tour and Travel Project - Full Stack Application

scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd admin && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
